scope: Independent source review of root-authored P04-17 Window integration only; excludes own History implementation
checks: Initial admission still requires valid P04-16 packet and Preparing with current real model target before opening an operation.
History observes only packets that pass Window identity/session/target/order checks; same-operation terminal sample normalization matches History duplicate rules.
Both current packet and history are updated before optional Page delivery, so reentrant Page callbacks observe current owner state.
The delivery to Page is the final operation in setEngineStatistics, with no subsequent Window member access after potentially deleting Page signal/event callbacks.
Window owns the ring independently of Page/tab lifetime; auxiliary Page close leaves it intact.
Fresh Page replay occurs after session-bound beginRequest and guarded Page selection, with QPointer/current widget checks after direct callbacks.
Session advance resets packet and history together before saved Statistics request begins; stale old-session packets cannot repopulate history.
No sampling/IO/timers/transfer side effects were added by this delta; existing graph snapshots are copied at delivery.
All unchanged Window source bytes equal the preserved parent snapshot after removing the explicitly reviewed integration delta.
limitations: New Page/graph implementation was not yet installed at this review; its own admission, session reset and Qt deletion behavior require separate review.
Snapshot/normalization allocations can throw; no allocator-fault or process memory cap is claimed.
Own History/API correctness is not counted as independently reviewed here; driver reviews that separately.
